question: Which of our brands drove gross profit last month?
interpretation: Estimated gross profit is SUM(sale_price - product cost) for completed items, never cost minus price. Product cost is the current catalog cost, so label it an estimate. Use the previous full calendar month.
sql:
SELECT p.brand AS brand,
  ROUND(SUM(oi.sale_price), 2) AS completed_revenue,
  ROUND(SUM(oi.sale_price - p.cost), 2) AS estimated_gross_profit,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(oi.sale_price - p.cost), SUM(oi.sale_price)), 4) AS margin_pct
FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.order_items` AS oi
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.products` AS p ON oi.product_id = p.id
WHERE oi.status = 'Complete'
  AND DATE(oi.created_at) >= DATE_SUB(DATE_TRUNC(CURRENT_DATE(), MONTH), INTERVAL 1 MONTH)
  AND DATE(oi.created_at) < DATE_TRUNC(CURRENT_DATE(), MONTH)
GROUP BY brand
ORDER BY estimated_gross_profit DESC
analyst_report:
Period: <month>. <top_brand> generated the largest estimated gross profit (<top_brand_profit>, margin <top_brand_margin>).
Mix: brands with high revenue but low margin may depend on discounting.
Caveats: cost is current catalog cost, not historical accounting cost.
Actions: review pricing for low-margin high-volume brands; protect stock for high-margin brands.
